{# The hero mark: three rings woven around a disc of the official art, the same weave the logo carries. Generated geometry -- three circles of radius 113 tilted 55 deg out of the screen plane and spun 0/60/120 deg about the view axis, cut at every horizon and crossing and painted back to front, so the over/under pattern is the one the solid would show. Each ring is a ribbon of filled quads whose width, depth brightness (--d) and glint (--s) are computed per sample; the stylesheet turns those into colour. Re-generate (tools/hero-knot/build.py) rather than edit by hand. #}
